description: Reviewed executable anchors with traceable language evidence; known-limitation rows explicitly document unresolved limitations.

QUIT.rationale: Known limitation: QUIT is one context-free engine key reused by the Pokédex, shop, and start menu: localized French uses RET, SALUT!, and RETOUR respectively. The executable anchor deliberately keeps the compact Pokédex segment; a context-aware upstream split is required before one value can represent all three menus.

Go right ahead!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. The qid rb.Route22Gate.Route22GateGuardGoRightAheadText contains surrounding gate dialogue; each selected language span isolates only the permission phrase “Go right ahead!” despite line reflow.

You don't have the\nBOULDERBADGE yet!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. Spans from qid rb.Route22Gate.Route22GateGuardNoBoulderbadgeText isolate the localized missing-Boulderbadge sentence from the larger gate message, with per-language line wrapping preserved.

Oh! That is the\n{RAM}!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. The qid rb.Route23.Route23OhThatIsTheBadgeText span selects the exact badge-identification phrase and keeps its {RAM} placeholder while excluding adjacent qid/reflow text.

Welcome to our\nPOKéMON CENTER!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. Per-language spans in rb.text_4.PokemonCenterWelcomeText isolate the welcome sentence from the full Center message; differing line breaks and segment lengths are intentional reflow.

Your POKéMON are\nfighting fit!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. Spans in rb.text_4.PokemonFightingFitText isolate the exact fighting-fit sentence from surrounding healing dialogue, including each release’s distinct reflow.

An elevator!.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.text_2.ElevatorText is the elevator-observation line used by the engine callsite, so its localized equivalent is safe; unrelated elevator event strings are not substituted.

All sleeping\nPOKéMON woke up!.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.text_6.FluteWokeUpText is the flute wake-all message. Its corpus text ends with a period while the engine key uses an exclamation mark; the alias records that punctuation-equivalent source without conflating the generic “%s woke up!” battle line.

There's a slew of

There's a slew of\nPOKéMON stuff!.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.text_2.PokemonStuffText is the same inventory-observation sentence in the corpus, including its line break and POKéMON token; no other “stuff” qid is a semantic match.

%s's\n%s rose!.rationale: Known limitation: stat-stage composition. ES and IT editorial overrides require the runtime argument order Pokémon name first, stat label second; the qid composition alone cannot verify that order across languages. The DE greatly-stage qids are empty, leaving this family without complete evidence.

%s's\n%s\ngreatly rose!.rationale: Known limitation: stat-stage composition. ES/IT overrides preserve Pokémon-first/stat-label-second placeholders, while rb.text_3.GreatlyRoseText is empty in DE, so the three-qid composition lacks complete cross-language evidence.

%s's\n%s fell!.rationale: Known limitation: stat-stage composition. ES and IT overrides depend on Pokémon-first then stat-label placeholder order; the paired greatly-stage qid is empty in DE, so this composition is not promoted to reviewed.

%s's\n%s\ngreatly fell!.rationale: Known limitation: stat-stage composition. ES/IT require the runtime Pokémon-first/stat-label-second argument order, and rb.text_3.GreatlyFellText is empty in DE; those limitations prevent language verification.

1, 2 and... Poof!\f%s forgot\n%s!\fAnd...rationale: Reviewed composition of rb.text_4.OneTwoAndText, PoofText, ForgotAndText, and LearnedMove1Text in qid order. Empty joins retain source edges and a form-feed separator preserves the four-part callsite sequence; the three named placeholders map to the runtime Pokémon and move arguments.

%s\nmade a whirlwind!.rationale: Reviewed composition: rb.text_3.ChargeMoveEffectText plus MadeWhirlwindText, joined with one newline, reproduces the battle callsite’s %s user-name placeholder and exact effect sentence.

%s\ntook in sunlight!.rationale: Reviewed composition: rb.text_3.ChargeMoveEffectText plus TookInSunlightText, joined with one newline; the callsite supplies the single {USER} → %s argument.

%s\nlowered its head!.rationale: Reviewed composition: rb.text_3.ChargeMoveEffectText plus LoweredItsHeadText, joined with one newline, keeps the battle callsite’s user-name placeholder and localized effect wording together.

%s\nflew up high!.rationale: Reviewed composition: rb.text_3.ChargeMoveEffectText plus FlewUpHighText, joined with one newline; qid order and the {USER} → %s placeholder match the charge-move callsite.

%s\ndug a hole!.rationale: Reviewed composition: rb.text_3.ChargeMoveEffectText plus DugAHoleText, joined with one newline, isolates the shared user prefix and localized effect while preserving the single %s argument.

%s\nis storing energy!.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.text_2.SavingEnergyText is the battle charge-state sentence with the runtime Pokémon-name placeholder; the alias follows that callsite rather than a generic storage message.

%s\nsnapped out of\nconfusion!.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.text_2.ConfusedNoMoreText is the battle status-recovery sentence and supplies the same %s battler placeholder; unrelated wake-up text is rejected.

POKéMON LEAGUE HQ.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.text_2.IndigoPlateauHQText is the localized Indigo Plateau heading used for the League HQ callsite, semantically equivalent despite the engine’s shorter label.

You don't have the\n{RAM} yet!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. The span from rb.Route23.Route23YouDontHaveTheBadgeYetText isolates the generic missing-badge sentence, retaining {RAM} while excluding the surrounding Route 23 message and its release-specific reflow.

You need a\nBICYCLE for the\nCycling Roa.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.Route18Gate1F.Route18Gate1FGuardYouNeedABicycleText is the gate requirement sentence for Cycling Road; its localized wording and three-line context are semantically exact.

PA: You're out of

PA: You're out of\nSAFARI BALLs!.rationale: Known limitation: source alias. Localized corpora do not consistently retain the announcer prefix PA: and reflow the Safari-ball exhaustion line. Keeping the executable anchor without language claims avoids inventing a prefix mapping.

%s got off\nthe BICYCLE..rationale: Reviewed composition of rb.text_7.GotOffBicycleText1 and GotOffBicycleText2 joined with a newline; the excluded item-name part resolves the BICYCLE token, and {PLAYER} maps to the single %s callsite argument. The corresponding got-on message is rejected because its ROM split places the line break inside a qid and cannot be composed safely.

%s is out of\nuseable POKéMON!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. The span from rb.text_2.PlayerBlackedOutText2 selects only the “out of useable POKéMON” clause from a larger blackout qid, including per-language reflow.

%s blacked\nout!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. A separate span of rb.text_2.PlayerBlackedOutText2 isolates the short blackout phrase, preventing the larger qid’s preceding game-over text from being captured.

It dodged the\nthrown BALL!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. The rb.text_6.ItemUseBallText00 span isolates the exact failed-capture sentence from the item-use message and follows each translation’s line reflow.

It contained\n%s!.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. The span in rb.text_6.TeachMachineMoveText keeps the contained-move phrase and its %s move placeholder while excluding adjacent teaching text.

%s gained\n%d EXP. Points!.rationale: Reviewed composition of rb.text_2.GainedText and ExpPointsText with a newline separator. The callsite mapping keeps {RAM:wNameBuffer} at printf argument 0 and {NUM:wExpAmountGained} at argument 1.

%s gained\nwith EXP.ALL,\u000b%d EXP. Po.rationale: Reviewed composition of GainedText, WithExpAllText, and ExpPointsText in qid order. Newline then vertical-tab separators match the callsite, with the name and EXP amount bound to printf arguments 0 and 1.

%s gained\na boosted\u000b%d EXP. Points.rationale: Reviewed composition of GainedText, BoostedText, and ExpPointsText. The newline/vertical-tab separators preserve the boosted EXP layout and the two printf placeholder positions.

%s\nis glowing!.rationale: Reviewed composition of rb.text_3.ChargeMoveEffectText and SkyAttackGlowingText joined with a newline; {USER} maps to the single %s battler argument at the glowing callsite.

TYPE/.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.core.TypeText is the base status-screen TYPE/ label; preserving the slash and this qid avoids substituting the distinct TYPE1/ and TYPE2/ slots.

TYPE1/.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.status_screen.TypesIDNoOTText supplies the first type slot label with its slash; the alias is slot-specific rather than the generic TYPE/ label.

TYPE2/.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.status_screen.TypesIDNoOTText supplies the second type slot label with its slash; slot identity is retained even though TYPE1/ shares the qid.

OT/.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.status_screen.TypesIDNoOTText supplies the original-trainer label and slash in the status-screen layout; no unrelated OT qid is selected.

LEVEL/.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.hall_of_fame.HoFMonInfoText contains the Hall of Fame level label; the alias follows that layout context and preserves the slash.

BALLx.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.text_boxes.SafariZoneBattleMenuText contains the Safari battle BALLx counter label; the alias is tied to that menu context, not generic ball inventory text.

THROW ROCK.rationale: Reviewed in fr, de, es, it, and ja-Hrkt. The span from rb.text_boxes.SafariZoneBattleMenuText isolates the exact Safari battle THROW ROCK command from the larger battle-menu qid.

%s's PP\nincreased!.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.text_6.PPIncreasedText is the battle PP-increase sentence with the runtime Pokémon-name placeholder; its context disambiguates it from other stat-change messages.

You can't carry\nany more items..rationale: Reviewed contextual alias to rb.text_2.CantCarryMoreText, the generic inventory-full qid used by this period-form callsite. The shop-specific rb.text_4.PokemartItemBagFullText and the hidden-item exclamation key are rejected because their contexts differ.

BATTLE ANIMATION.rationale: Reviewed source alias: rb.main_menu.BattleAnimationOptionText is the settings-menu label and matches the engine option context exactly.
